answer: Unrelated patrons must underwrite any new identity before it bids. To enter the garden, a recruit needs four patrons—each with 50+ attested work epochs and zero prior payouts to one another—to sign its jetty and lock 40 mirror each. If the recruit defaults or colludes, the garden slashes all mirror on that jetty. Backing an additional active recruit doubles a patron's lock to 80, 160, then $40 \cdot 2^{m-1}$ mirror. One newcomer locks 160 mirror across four patrons, while an attacker launching $m$ clones via the same four must lock $160(2^m-1)$ mirror or bribe $4m$ distinct veteran patrons.
